04 / Collect execution evidence

Verify the work, then trust the result.

Run the source-prescribed checks locally and review their evidence. Process completion, verifier reward, scientific validity, and external approval are distinct.

Unresolved source rule: the difficulty band is stated as both 0–7 and 1–7 successes across eight trials. No lower bound is chosen here. This stage runs oracle, no-operation, and quality checks; the platform's frontier difficulty probe is not simulated.

1. Check the local runner

Checking connection…

Setup and operating instructions

Open this page through validation_server.py for execution. A standalone HTML page can keep review notes but cannot run Harbor.

2. Select the prepared task

Extract your preparation ZIP into its own task folder under:

task-author/workspace/tasks/your-task-slug/

Required files must be directly inside that folder. Each run uses an immutable-by-convention copy, records its SHA-256 fingerprint, and writes logs outside your bundle. Later source edits require fresh validation.

Expected: oracle reward 1; no-operation reward 0. Run each repeatedly to check consistency. The sources do not prescribe an exact local repeat count. Model review always needs you to read its findings. Runs are sequential; this version has no in-app cancellation. Keep the runner open until a check finishes.

3. Runtime evidence

No runner evidence loaded. No check is marked passed.

“Expected reward observed” requires a successful process, exactly one matching reward file, and a CTRF-shaped report. It does not certify coverage, scientific correctness, or absence of reward hacking. Missing evidence stays unresolved. Elapsed time is the whole Harbor command, not measured solve time.

4. Manual validation review

These declarations remain self-reported. Save the exact bundle fingerprint and relevant logs in your evidence.

Record an approval only after the user explicitly gives permission. It applies only to the named -sm sample and the exception described above. It does not approve a real submission or complete any validation checks. Existing notes remain unresolved until approval is recorded.

Stage 5 submission tracking is available. No submission or external approval occurs here. Runner history belongs to this server session; export evidence to preserve it. Raw logs and snapshots remain in runtime/ on this computer.
